provenance.note: Erode district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope erode-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-erode). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/erode-rivers/tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: Erode CEPI core zone: outer frame
properties.whatThisIs: A polygon through the eight boundary reference points the plan prints (Table 1.1). It encloses 55.3 sq km; the plan gives the core zone as 45.25 sq km, so the true boundary lies inside this frame. The plan's own map is an image.
properties.cepiScore: 60.33 (Air 34.12, Water 47, Land 52.75), declared by CPCB for 2017-18: a Severely Polluted Area
properties.laterScore: 25.02 on TNPCB's post-monsoon 2019 recalculation (plan, printed p.57)
properties.unitsInThePlan: 849 Red and Orange category units in the CEPI area (plan, printed p.9)
properties.source: TNPCB, CEPI action plan for the Erode industrial cluster, September 2020 (CPCB website)
